intelligence.essence: Anything created for Shawn or shared with him is obsidian black, at the highest quality, matching the NayaNET brand. No white backgrounds — ever.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a beautiful black jewel box! Everything inside it is dark and shiny and glows like a real jewel. Now imagine someone handed you a plain white box instead — you couldn't even see what's inside properly! That's why everything for Shawn comes in the black jewel box. Always black. Always beautiful. Never white!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — Shawn can't read a white background, dear, it just doesn't go well for his eyes. So everything we make for him, everything we share with him, comes in obsidian black, dear — the beautiful dark of the NayaNET brand, at the very highest quality. No white pages, no white documents, no white shares, love. Black, always black, so he can read every word in comfort.
